```{python}
import pandas as pd

def qb_epa_by_game(data: pd.DataFrame, team_col: str = "posteam") -> pd.DataFrame:

    important = {"game_id", "qb_epa", "play_id", team_col}
    missing = important - set(data.columns)
    if missing:
        raise KeyError(f"missing required columns: {sorted(missing)}")

    data = data.copy()

    if "qb_dropback" in data.columns:
        dropback_mask = (lambda col: data[col].astype("float64").fillna(0.0).astype(bool))("qb_dropback")
    else:
        dropback_mask = data["qb_epa"].notna()

    mask = dropback_mask & data[team_col].notna() & data["qb_epa"].notna()

    if "qb_spike" in data.columns:
        mask &= ~(lambda col: data[col].astype("float64").fillna(0.0).astype(bool))("qb_spike")

    if "qb_kneel" in data.columns:
        mask &= ~(lambda col: data[col].astype("float64").fillna(0.0).astype(bool))("qb_kneel")

    if "two_point_attempt" in data.columns:
        mask &= ~(lambda col: data[col].astype("float64").fillna(0.0).astype(bool))("two_point_attempt")

    if "season_type" in data.columns:
        mask &= (data["season_type"] == "REG")

    dff = data.loc[mask, ["game_id", team_col, "qb_epa", "play_id"]].copy()

    output = (
        dff.groupby(["game_id", team_col], as_index=False)
           .agg(
               qb_total_epa=("qb_epa", "sum"),
               qb_dropbacks=("play_id", "nunique")  # count distinct QB-involved plays
           )
           .rename(columns={team_col: "posteam"})
           .sort_values(["game_id", "posteam"], ignore_index=True)
    )
    return output


qb_game = qb_epa_by_game(data)

print(qb_game.head())
```

```{python}
from typing import Optional

def feature_per_game(data: pd.DataFrame, value_col: str, team_col: str, where: Optional[Callable[[pd.DataFrame], pd.Series]] = None):

    needed = {"game_id", team_col, "play_id", value_col}
    missing = needed - set(data.columns)
    if missing:
        raise KeyError(f"Missing required columns: {sorted(missing)}")
    df = data.copy()

    mask = df[value_col].notna() & df[team_col].notna() ## make mask for rows where value is present and team exists

    dff = df.loc[mask, ["game_id", team_col, value_col, "play_id"]]

    out = (
        dff.groupby(["game_id", team_col], as_index=False)
           .agg(
               total=(value_col, "sum"),
               count=("play_id", "nunique")  # distinct plays
           )
           .rename(columns={team_col: "posteam"})  # standardize for build_features
           .sort_values(["game_id", "posteam"], ignore_index=True)
    )
    return out
```

```{python}
from typing import Callable

def build_features(data: pd.DataFrame, week: int, function: Callable[[pd.DataFrame], pd.DataFrame], *, team_col: str = "posteam", total_col: str = "total", count_col: str = "count", rate_name: str = "prior_rate"):

    if "game_id" not in data.columns or "week" not in data.columns:

        raise KeyError("data frame must contain game_id and week columns")

    game_level = function(data) # function to get per_game data

    game_info = data[["game_id", "week"]].drop_duplicates()
    game_level = game_level.merge(game_info, on="game_id", how="left")
    game_level = game_level.loc[game_level['week'] < week].copy()

    agg = (
        game_level.groupby("posteam", as_index=False)
                  .agg(
                      **{f"prior_{total_col}": (total_col, "sum"),
                         f"prior_{count_col}": (count_col, "sum")}
                  )
    )

    agg["week"] = week
    agg[rate_name] = np.where(
        agg[f"prior_{count_col}"] > 0,
        agg[f"prior_{total_col}"] / agg[f"prior_{count_col}"],
        np.nan
    )

    return agg[["week", "posteam",
                f"prior_{total_col}", f"prior_{count_col}", rate_name]]

```

)
